newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Communications inks 2-year AT&T pact.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Communications inks 2-year AT&T pact.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc said Friday it entered a two-year contract to provide turn-key marketing services to AT&T in its pursuit of business customers.
Snyder Communications said it has been providing targeted marketing services to AT&T since 1990.
Prior to entering this new contract, however, the company's role has been limited to assisting AT&T increase its market share in the consumer long-distance markets.

As a result of this new contract, Snyder Communications said it will now also provide similar services to assist AT&T in signing up small- and medium-sized business customers to its long distance, Intralata, toll-free and calling card services.
